name: Villeguillo (Spain)
description: Square green flag with a blue wavy horizontal stripe across the centre, charged with the crowned municipal arms of Villeguillo (a saltire on yellow, a tree and an aqueduct).
history: The arms and flag of Villeguillo were published in the Boletín Oficial de Castilla y León on 30 September 1997; the flag is square, of proportion 1:1, green, with a blue wavy fess and the municipal arms in its colours at the centre.
